name: MFJ, both 65+, W-2 plus bank interest (senior deduction for both)
source: Worked by hand from the 2025 Form 1040, Schedule 1-A, Schedule B and i1040gi. 1a 60,000; 2b 2,000 (Schedule B: over 1,500); 9 = 11a = 62,000; 12e from the chart for people born before January 2, 1961: MFJ with 2 boxes = 34,700.
